children: Nova reported geotechnical drilling underway for the West Susitna Access Road and AIDEA approved up to $25 million in additional funding.
AIDEA authorized up to $25 million to advance geotechnical drilling and essential works for the 78.5-mile West Susitna Access Road.
Road will be year-round, all-weather access linking Estelle Project to Port MacKenzie, lowering development costs and improving logistics.
ADOT&PF geotechnical fieldwork largely completed at key material sites and bridge crossings; further investigations slated for 2027.
Funding will also progress permitting, hydrologic, engineering and access work that supports road construction and resource development.
Nova is advancing a vertically integrated antimony refinery in Port MacKenzie, with Phase 1 funded by a $43.4M DoW award.

title: Nova: AIDEA approves up to $25M to advance West Susitna Access Road as geotechnical drilling begins
